The oval held 20 of 20 at max_error 0.0165, and the s-bend reached 19 of 20 with line losses 0.8 and oscillation 0.32, under the 0.35 limit. If the s-bend drops below 19 finishes, speed is costing bend time, so return to base_speed 1.5 and consider a kd change instead. If the slalom stays at its max_error floor with 0 finishes, geometry and speed have both reached their limit, and the next move should be a track width trial.
